description: Erection of a single storey side extension. Replace existing part-pitch / part-flat single storey roof to the rear with a new flat rubber roof with low level parapet walls to the perimeter. Addition of first floor rear window.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Site Location Plan, Block Plan - Existing, Block Plan - Proposed, 001, 002, 003, 004, Flood Risk Assessment dated 11th November 2020, Cover Letter dated 11th November 2020. Drawings received 18th November 2020) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
